# Set Up
```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
 
Packages <- c("tidyverse")
lapply(Packages, library, character.only = TRUE)
```

```{r set_path}
png_path <- "../../results/untargeted/combined_datasets"
csv_path <- "../../results/untargeted/combined_datasets/csv"
svg_path <- "../../results/untargeted/combined_datasets/svg"
data_path <- "../../data"
```

# Load Data

## Batch 1
```{r load-batch1}
# Peak Area Values
batch1_peak_area <- read_csv('../../results/untargeted/Batch1_peak_area_values.csv',
                              show_col_types = FALSE)

# Metabolite Annotations
batch1_metabolite_annotations <- read_csv('../../results/untargeted/Batch1_metabolite_annotations.csv',
                                          show_col_types = FALSE)

# Sample Metadata
batch1_sample_metadata <- read_csv('../../results/untargeted/Batch1_sample_metadata.csv',
                                   show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Batch 2
```{r load-batch2}
# Peak Area Values
batch2_peak_area <- read_csv('../../results/untargeted/Batch2_peak_area_values.csv',
                              show_col_types = FALSE)

# Metabolite Annotations
batch2_metabolite_annotations <- read_csv('../../results/untargeted/Batch2_metabolite_annotations.csv',
                                          show_col_types = FALSE)

# Sample Metadata
batch2_sample_metadata <- read_csv('../../results/untargeted/Batch2_sample_metadata.csv',
                                   show_col_types = FALSE)
```

# Data Inspection
```{r inspect-dimensions}
# Check dimensions
cat("Batch 1 Peak Data:", nrow(batch1_peak_area), "metabolites x", 
    ncol(batch1_peak_area) - 3, "samples\n")
cat("Batch 2 Peak Data:", nrow(batch2_peak_area), "metabolites x", 
    ncol(batch2_peak_area) - 3, "samples\n")

# Check for overlapping metabolites by Name
batch1_metabolites <- batch1_peak_area$Name
batch2_metabolites <- batch2_peak_area$Name

overlap <- intersect(batch1_metabolites, batch2_metabolites)
cat("\nOverlapping metabolites (by Name):", length(overlap), "\n")
cat("Batch 1 unique:", length(setdiff(batch1_metabolites, batch2_metabolites)), "\n")
cat("Batch 2 unique:", length(setdiff(batch2_metabolites, batch1_metabolites)), "\n")

# Show example overlapping metabolites
if (length(overlap) > 0) {
  cat("\nExample overlapping metabolites:\n")
  print(head(overlap, 10))
}
```
# Prepare Data for Combining
`````{r prepare-data}
# Add batch identifier to Compound.IDs for trace-ability
batch1_peak_area <- batch1_peak_area %>%
  mutate(Compound.ID_Batch1 = Compound.ID) %>%
  select(Name, Compound.ID_Batch1, everything(), -Compound.ID, -Formula)

batch2_peak_area <- batch2_peak_area %>%
  mutate(Compound.ID_Batch2 = Compound.ID) %>%
  select(Name, Compound.ID_Batch2, everything(), -Compound.ID, -Formula)
`````

# Combine Peak Area Data
````{r combine-peak-area}
# Full join on Name to merge same metabolites regardless of Compound.ID
combined_peak_area <- batch1_peak_area %>%
  full_join(batch2_peak_area, 
            by = "Name")

# Get all column names
all_cols <- colnames(combined_peak_area)

# Identify which columns got .x and .y suffixes
x_cols <- grep("\\.x$", all_cols, value = TRUE)
y_cols <- grep("\\.y$", all_cols, value = TRUE)

cat("Columns with .x suffix:", length(x_cols), "\n")
cat("Columns with .y suffix:", length(y_cols), "\n")

# For Compound.ID columns, keep both with proper names
if ("Compound.ID_Batch1.x" %in% all_cols) {
  combined_peak_area <- combined_peak_area %>%
    rename(Compound.ID_Batch1 = Compound.ID_Batch1.x)
}

if ("Compound.ID_Batch1.y" %in% all_cols) {
  combined_peak_area <- combined_peak_area %>%
    mutate(Compound.ID_Batch1 = coalesce(Compound.ID_Batch1, Compound.ID_Batch1.y)) %>%
    select(-Compound.ID_Batch1.y)
}

if ("Compound.ID_Batch2.x" %in% all_cols) {
  combined_peak_area <- combined_peak_area %>%
    rename(temp_b2 = Compound.ID_Batch2.x)
  if ("Compound.ID_Batch2.y" %in% colnames(combined_peak_area)) {
    combined_peak_area <- combined_peak_area %>%
      mutate(Compound.ID_Batch2 = coalesce(temp_b2, Compound.ID_Batch2.y)) %>%
      select(-temp_b2, -Compound.ID_Batch2.y)
  } else {
    combined_peak_area <- combined_peak_area %>%
      rename(Compound.ID_Batch2 = temp_b2)
  }
}

if ("Compound.ID_Batch2.y" %in% all_cols & !"Compound.ID_Batch2" %in% colnames(combined_peak_area)) {
  combined_peak_area <- combined_peak_area %>%
    rename(Compound.ID_Batch2 = Compound.ID_Batch2.y)
}

# For sample columns (which should not have duplicates since samples are unique to each batch)
# Remove .x and .y suffixes
combined_peak_area <- combined_peak_area %>%
  rename_with(~str_remove(., "\\.x$"), ends_with(".x")) %>%
  rename_with(~str_remove(., "\\.y$"), ends_with(".y"))

# Reorder columns
combined_peak_area <- combined_peak_area %>%
  select(Name, 
         starts_with("Compound.ID_Batch"), 
         everything())

# Add batch detection flags
combined_peak_area <- combined_peak_area %>%
  mutate(
    Detected_Batch1 = !is.na(Compound.ID_Batch1),
    Detected_Batch2 = !is.na(Compound.ID_Batch2),
    Detected_Both = Detected_Batch1 & Detected_Batch2
  )

# Get actual sample columns (exclude Name, Compound.IDs, and detection flags)
sample_cols <- colnames(combined_peak_area)[!colnames(combined_peak_area) %in% 
                c("Name", "Compound.ID_Batch1", "Compound.ID_Batch2",
                  "Detected_Batch1", "Detected_Batch2", "Detected_Both")]

cat("\nCombined peak data:", nrow(combined_peak_area), "metabolites x", 
    length(sample_cols), "samples\n")
````
# Combine Metabolite Annotations
```{r combine-annotations}
# Add batch identifier to Compound.IDs
batch1_metabolite_annotations <- batch1_metabolite_annotations %>%
  mutate(Compound.ID_Batch1 = Compound.ID,
         Batch = "Batch1") %>%
  select(-Compound.ID)

batch2_metabolite_annotations <- batch2_metabolite_annotations %>%
  mutate(Compound.ID_Batch2 = Compound.ID,
         Batch = "Batch2") %>%
  select(-Compound.ID)

# Stack them on top of each other
combined_annotations <- bind_rows(batch1_metabolite_annotations,
                                  batch2_metabolite_annotations)

# Filter to only include compounds present in combined peak area
compounds_in_peak <- unique(c(
  combined_peak_area$Compound.ID_Batch1[!is.na(combined_peak_area$Compound.ID_Batch1)],
  combined_peak_area$Compound.ID_Batch2[!is.na(combined_peak_area$Compound.ID_Batch2)]
))

combined_annotations <- combined_annotations %>%
  filter(
    (Batch == "Batch1" & Compound.ID_Batch1 %in% compounds_in_peak) |
    (Batch == "Batch2" & Compound.ID_Batch2 %in% compounds_in_peak)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Name)

# Reorder columns - Compound.IDs and Batch first
combined_annotations <- combined_annotations %>%
  select(Compound.ID_Batch1, Compound.ID_Batch2, Batch, everything())

cat("Combined annotations:", nrow(combined_annotations), "rows\n")
cat("Batch 1 annotations:", sum(combined_annotations$Batch == "Batch1"), "\n")
cat("Batch 2 annotations:", sum(combined_annotations$Batch == "Batch2"), "\n")
```

# Combine Sample Metadata
```{r combine-metadata}
# Add batch identifier to metadata
batch1_sample_metadata <- batch1_sample_metadata %>%
  mutate(Batch = "Batch1")

batch2_sample_metadata <- batch2_sample_metadata %>%
  mutate(Batch = "Batch2")

# Combine metadata by stacking
combined_sample_metadata <- bind_rows(
  batch1_sample_metadata,
  batch2_sample_metadata
) %>%
  select(Sample, Batch, GW, Sex)  # Reorder with Batch after Sample

cat("Combined samples:", nrow(combined_sample_metadata), "\n")
cat("Batch 1 samples:", sum(combined_sample_metadata$Batch == "Batch1"), "\n")
cat("Batch 2 samples:", sum(combined_sample_metadata$Batch == "Batch2"), "\n")

# Summary by sex and batch
cat("\nSample distribution:\n")
print(combined_sample_metadata %>%
        group_by(Batch, Sex) %>%
        summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop"))
```
# Save Combined Data
```{r save-combined}
# Save combined datasets with "full dataset" naming
write_csv(combined_peak_area, 
          file.path(data_path, 'full_dataset_peak_area_values.csv'))

write_csv(combined_annotations, 
          file.path(data_path, 'full_dataset_metabolite_annotations.csv'))

write_csv(combined_sample_metadata, 
          file.path(data_path, 'full_dataset_sample_metadata.csv'))

cat("\nAll combined datasets saved successfully to:", data_path, "\n")
cat("Files saved:\n")
cat("  - full_dataset_peak_area_values.csv\n")
cat("  - full_dataset_metabolite_annotations.csv\n")
cat("  - full_dataset_sample_metadata.csv\n")
```
